name: Jammer - Dodge

60111.name: Dodge RES I
60111.SpecificEffects:
In combat, the enemy's Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>-4%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+6%</color>.

RelatedDescription: An ST backpack fitted with high-frequency jamming wave emitters that affect the Dodge capability of the enemy by overlapping wave bands.
